finding.title: Input Validation
finding.trigger: If an attacker provides a negative or very large value for q
finding.assumptions: The program does not validate the input for q, which could lead to an infinite loop or excessive resource consumption.

finding.title: Integer Overflow
finding.untrusted_source: m and n are derived from user input indirectly through loops
finding.sink: int b = 2 * m * n; int c = m * m + n * n;
finding.trigger: If m and n are large enough, the multiplication operations could overflow.
finding.assumptions: The program does not check for integer overflow when calculating b and c.
